**Hint 1:** Recall that the objective function $R(	heta) $$=$$  rac{1}{3}\sum_{i=1}**{3}(x_i - 	heta)**{2}$ is a quadratic function in terms of $	heta$. The minimum of a quadratic function $a	heta**2 + $$btheta$$ + c$ occurs at $	heta $$=$$ - rac{b}{2a}$. Try to express $R(	heta)$ in this form to find the value of $	heta$ that minimizes it.

**Hint 2:** Consider the properties of the mean and variance. The objective function $R(	heta)$ is minimized when $	heta$ is the mean of the data points. Calculate the mean of the data points {1, $$6$$, 17} to find the value of $	heta$ that minimizes the function.
